html:
Question 1
?

Which of the following gives the line integral of the function f(x,y)=xy, traversed once along the circle C with equation (x+1)2+y2=25?

a
25∫02πsin⁡t(cos⁡t−sin⁡t)dt
b
5∫02πsin⁡t(cos⁡t−5)dt
c
25∫02πsin⁡t(cos⁡t−5)dt
d
5∫02πsin⁡t(5cos⁡t−1)dt
e
25∫02πsin⁡t(5cos⁡t−1)dt
Submit
